evidence: Spelling: extracted all 640 distinct word tokens from instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md and reviewed them; no misspellings found (all tokens are standard English words, proper names from seed, or technical identifiers). Contamination grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|<tag>|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|lorem|tbd over the three files: zero hits; the template's 'CHANGE_ME' placeholder has been fully replaced. All three files are pure ASCII with LF endings (no CR, no mojibake). No author asides, no duplicated paragraphs, no foreign machine paths; every path used (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md) is the task's own runtime contract. Internal consistency: password 'Hireops!2026' identical in instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md section 1; the 10 accounts and roles listed in instruction.md:17 match seed_data.json users exactly (3 recruiter, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidate); one seed path (/assets/seed_data.json) everywhere; one DB path (/app/app.db with DB_PATH) in instruction.md:13, integration.md:7 and hireops_rules.md:201; port 3000 with PORT honoured (instruction.md:13) is compatible with integration.md:5 and the launch env list at hireops_rules.md:202; health 'never touches the database' (instruction.md:13) is compatible with 'answers before database work can block startup' (integration.md); rules' activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' uses real seed names; three jobs and page size 30 in rules section 9 match seed (jobs=3, thread_page_size=30); candidate wording table in rules section 7 matches seed candidate_status_labels. instruction.md:3 'undo ... as long as nobody has touched those cards since' is refined (not contradicted) by hireops_rules.md:97-99, which defines the changes that block undo and says adding a note does not count; the brief explicitly defers 'The exact stage rules' to that file (instruction.md:11). Minor non-defects recorded: (a) mixed British/American variants 'honour'/'honouring' (instruction.md:13) vs 'Honor'/'honoring' (hireops_rules.md:201, integration.md:7) are valid spellings, not errors; (b) hireops_rules.md lines 91, 99, 112, 173 show uneven hard-wrapping (a short line ending 'all the rules above,' and over-long lines of 141-169 chars) — an editing seam invisible in rendered Markdown and with no content duplication or contradiction. Adversarial probe: this row concerns brief text only; no broken app can exploit it and no conforming app can be failed by it, since no spelling slip or contradiction yields a second reading of any requirement. Deterministic counterparts check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py were not executed by me (belongs to the deterministic reviewer); my manual grep found no TODO/FIXME markers and the brief is far above 40 words.
